dimensions.assessment: Affects Armed Forces members assigned to Marine Corps Installations Pacific in Okinawa, Japan, and their adult dependents.
dimensions.evidence: assigned to Marine Corps Installations Pacific in Okinawa, Japan, and the adult dependents of such members

dimensions.assessment: Automatically enrolls participants to receive informational text messages regarding employment, childcare, TRICARE, and policies, with an opt-out choice.
dimensions.evidence: automatically enroll all eligible members... provide all recipients with the ability to opt out

dimensions.assessment: Requires a pilot program and subsequent cost analysis report, but specifies no budget amounts.
dimensions.evidence: an analysis of the costs of operating the pilot program

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a localized pilot text notification program with mandatory evaluation and reporting to congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: establish a pilot program to be known as the 'Push-Text Initiative'

dimensions.assessment: Authorized as a pilot program with a mandated report due by October 1, 2027, and potential consideration for broader rollout.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than October 1, 2027, the Secretary of Defense shall submit... a report on the pilot program.

missing_information: Exact financial cost to set up and operate the text messaging system.
Total number of service members and dependents residing at the specified installation.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill requires the Secretary of Defense to establish a pilot text messaging initiative for service members assigned to Marine Corps Installations Pacific in Okinawa, Japan, and their adult dependents, to provide automated information about benefits, policies, and resources.

label: H.R. 6490

latest_action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Armed Services.

title: To direct the Secretary of Defense to establish a pilot program to provide certain members of the Armed Forces with timely and relevant information via text message, and for other purposes.
